info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Get Consumer Service By Param1-spec
info.description: The Trust Services Retrieval API allows consumers to access specific trust services based on defined parameters. This endpoint enables users to fetch detailed information about trust services by providing a unique identifier. Typical use cases include retrieving service offerings for clients seeking trust management assistance or regulatory compliance solutions. Ideal for financial institutions and advisors, this API supports integration into applications managing client service portfolios.

get.description: Fetches details of the specified trust service identified by the resource ID RES-100045. This endpoint allows consumers to obtain crucial information regarding the trust service's specifications and attributes.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to retrieve trust service details for a specific consumer service identified by RES-100045. Ensure that the JSON structure adheres to the defined schema for a successful response.
